author: New China TV
description: Chinese scientists set off on the country's 16th Arctic expedition on Friday as three oceanographic research ships, namely Xuelong, Xuelong 2 and Jidi, departed from the coastal city of Dalian in northeast China's Liaoning Province. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Chinese research ships depart on 16th Arctic expedition

author: New China TV
description: Xi Jinping, chairman of the Central Military Commission (CMC), on Friday presented certificates of order to promote two military officers to the rank of general at a ceremony in Beijing. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Xi presents orders to promote two military officers to rank of general

description: President Xi Jinping's speech at a gathering in celebration of the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China (CPC) has been published by the People's Publishing House. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Xi's speech at gathering marking CPC's 105th founding anniversary published

author: New China TV
description: A breeding colony of greater crested terns (China's second-class protected species) has been confirmed on Zhongshazhou, an island of China's Xisha Qundao in the South China Sea. By July 1, scientists had spotted about 300 birds and nearly 200 nests. #GreaterCrestedTern #seabirds #SouthChinaSea #XishaQundao #AmazingChina #BirdWatching
title: Greater crested tern breeding colony confirmed in South China Sea

author: New China TV
description: Have you ever heard a koala's voice? A female koala at a zoo in Nanjing, east China's Jiangsu Province was recently recorded making a call that sounded surprisingly like a motorbike engine. #Koala #Wildlife #Nature #FunnyAnimals
title: Koala at Nanjing zoo recorded making motorbike-like call

author: New China TV
description:
What's behind China's development?
A Pakistani researcher points to two key ideas: people-centered policies and long-term consistency.
From tailored poverty alleviation to rapid urban innovation, she says China's approach is not one-size-fits-all, but locally adapted and constantly evolving. #GLOBALink
title: People-centered approach, consistency key to China's development: Pakistani researcher

author: New China TV
description: More foreign visitors are coming to China, and the travel experience is improving across the board. Digital services, transport links, and payment systems are all becoming more accessible. #ChinaTravel
title: Trendy China | #ChinaTravel: More visitors, easier journeys

author: New China TV
description: The main structure of Wanzhou North Railway Station's expansion was completed on Thursday, with capacity growing from 4 to 7 platforms and floor space doubling to 35,000 square meters. #ChinaInfrastructure #RailwayStation
title: Main structure completed for railway station expansion in SW China

author: New China TV
description:
Does developing #AI necessarily mean fewer jobs?
A New York Times article examines how #China is trying to balance technological progress with job creation and worker protection.
title: Does AI mean fewer jobs? NYT says China seeks a balance

author: New China TV
description: A new buzzword is making the rounds -- "China Opportunity 2.0". It captures how the world's second-largest economy is evolving beyond its low-cost manufacturing past. From open-source #AI to high-tech R&D hubs, China is redefining its role in the global economy. But what does this shift actually look like on the ground? Click to find out.
title: Trendy China | "China Opportunity 2.0": What's new?

author: New China TV
description:
This year marks the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China (CPC). Xinhuanet presents "The Path to Success," a series bringing together leaders from political parties around the world to share their views on the CPC's governance practices and development experiences.
In this episode, Milenko Jovanov, member of the Presidency of the ruling Serbian Progressive Party (SNS), said the CPC has continuously adjusted its governance approach based on practical experience while staying true to its core principles and serving the people.
title: China Trends | Caring for people is key to CPC's success: SNS presidency member

author: New China TV
description:
Half gold, half green. 
In Mulei County, NW China's Xinjiang, farmland has transformed into a giant natural palette. Golden wheat and vibrant bean fields stretch across the hillsides, showcasing the centuries-old wisdom of China's dryland farming. #Xinjiang #China #Farming #Nature #SummerViews
title: Half gold, half green: Nature's masterpiece on the farmland

author: New China TV
description: "I want to be a bridge between Chinese and foreign cultures, a bridge between knowledge and fun, and a bridge between the young and the ancient," said Du Ying, a university teacher, children's book author, and member of the Communist Party of China (CPC). Through comics and storytelling, she brings Chinese culture to life for children around the world.
title: Building bridges through stories | A CPC member connecting cultures

author: New China TV
description:
What does 15 years of agricultural cooperation look like?
In Tanzania, it means higher-yield rice varieties, better farming techniques and thousands of trained farmers.
Thanks to long-term cooperation with Chinese agronomists, Tanzania's annual rice production has reached 2.2 million tonnes, ranking fourth in Africa.
title: GLOBALink | Chinese agronomists help boost rice production in Tanzania
